content: धुर्य {%a.%} [धुरं वहति, यत्] .²1 Fit for a burden, able to bear a burden <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 Fit to be entrusted with important duties. .²3 Standing at the head, chief, foremost; see below. .{@-र्यः@} .²1 A beast of burden. .²2 A horse or bullock yoked to the pole of a carriage; नाविनीतैर्व्रजेद् धुर्यैः <ls>Ms. 4. 67</ls>; येनेदं ध्रियते विश्वं धुर्यैर्यानमिवाध्वनि <ls>Ku. 6. 76</ls>; धुर्यान् विश्रामयेति <ls>R. 1. 54</ls>, <ls n="R.">6. 78</ls>, <ls n="R.">17. 19</ls>. .²3 One who carries a burden (of responsibility); तस्या भवानपरधुर्यपदावलम्बी <ls>R. 5. 66</ls>. .²4 A chief, leader, head; न हि सति कुलधुर्ये सूर्यवंश्या गृहाय <ls>R. 7. 71</ls>. .²5 A minister, one charged with important duties; ततो युगंधराख्यस्य हस्ते धुर्यस्य मन्त्रिणः <ls>Ks. 9. 14</ls>. .²6 An epithet of Viṣṇu. .{@-र्यम्@} The forepart of a pole.
